gen-gf-cherry-swash-ibm-plex-sans: Cherry Swash arrives with a wide horseshoe c and a ruler-and-compass line. IBM Plex Sans is the quieter one, offering a wide channel into every bowl where the heading is all showmanship.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-zilla-slab: Heavy diagonals as thick as the verticals mark Cherry Swash. Zilla Slab brings a sturdy, technical footing beneath it, and that mix of showy pen pressure and slab-serif toughness is what holds the pair together.
gen-gf-comic-relief-clash-grotesk: Bold and unfussy, Comic Relief has bowls left open on one side. Clash Grotesk follows in a plain sans with no thick-and-thin modulation, so shrinking the heading would let the two blur together.
gen-gf-comic-relief-fs-alpino: Comic Relief hits hard, its strokes uniform and its bowls left open. Alpino sits below with cozy, casual sans-serif letters, tall enough that its ascenders look short, so the heading gets the loudness and the text gets the ease.
gen-gf-comic-relief-fs-familjen-grotesk: Loud, blunt, unfinished bowls. Comic Relief draws every vertical and horizontal at identical weight, while Familjen Grotesk, a lively plain sans with taller lowercase, gives the text a quicker, lighter stride underneath.
gen-gf-comic-relief-fs-hind: Comic Relief leads with bold strokes that look the same going up or sideways. Hind follows in a plain sans whose lowercase nearly matches its capitals, and its c never turns inward, which gives the text a level, drawn-string steadiness.
gen-gf-comic-relief-fs-nunito: Strokes that look identical in every direction give Comic Relief its blunt, commanding face. Nunito, a sans-serif with big round lowercase bowls and terminals finishing clear of the stem, softens the page beneath it.
gen-gf-comic-relief-fs-pilcrow-rounded: Pilcrow Rounded packs its letters tightly, with big counters, tall lowercase and curves that refuse to close. Comic Relief takes the heading role with bold, uniform strokes, and Pilcrow Rounded keeps the sans text warm and compact below it.
gen-gf-comic-relief-fs-quicksand: Quicksand has tall lowercase bowls like blown glass bulbs. Its bars keep an identical thickness across the line, which makes it a gentle foil for the blunt, commanding strokes of Comic Relief.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-alan-sans: Alan Sans reads modern and businesslike, with curve tails held well back. Comic Relief sits above it, bold and commanding, with full-width stroke connections where thin hairline joins would be, so the heading looks cut from a heavier block.
